core_obligations: Replace Y by its normalization and let X_0 -> X be the normalization; the morphism factors through X_0, so assume X and Y normal.

By the codimension-1 isomorphism lemma f is an isomorphism over an open containing every codimension 0 and 1 point and every point with finite fibre, so there is a finite set of closed points T with f an isomorphism over X minus T.
An admissible blowup Y' -> X dominating Y exists; after replacing by the normalization of Y' the morphism Y -> X is representable.

For T = {x_1, ..., x_r} pick elementary etale neighbourhoods (U_i, u_i); each Y_i -> U_i is proper birational and an isomorphism off u_i, so the scheme-case lemma gives a normalized blowup sequence over u_i dominating Y_i.
Assemble the global normalized blowup sequence X_m -> ... -> X_0 = X through the sequence-equivalence lemma and conclude X_m dominates Y by the equivalence of categories.
proof_roadmap: Normalization reduction; codimension-1 isomorphism forcing a finite exceptional set; admissible blowup domination; per-neighbourhood scheme-case sequences; global assembly and domination conclusion.
difficulty_reason: A multi-step reduction to the scheme case: normalization replacements, the finite exceptional set, admissible blowup domination, and the two-lemma assembly of the global sequence tie five citations into one construction.
